setup.paper_quote: Ten-fold cross validation on SCUT-FBP. Six measures: Chebyshev, Clark, Sorensen, Topsoe, Cosine, Intersection.
setup.deviation_from_paper: 500-image SCUT-FBP with ten-fold CV, versus 1,399 images on a fixed split. Early stopping on the validation split (patience 5) replaces the paper's fixed schedule: benchmark-v1 is a single fixed split, so a fixed epoch count would report whatever the last epoch produced rather than the method's best honest result.
setup.notes: The paper's SLDL is a structural SVM over label distributions, not a CNN. This entry keeps the *objective* -- predict the rating distribution, evaluate with distribution measures -- on the same backbone as every other deep entry, so the comparison isolates the objective rather than confounding it with the model class. The paper's Sorensen and Topsoe are replaced by KL and Canberra in this benchmark's metric set.
